The check passes today (13 passed, exit 0) even though the issue explicitly states the warnings *do* currently appear when running without `-W error::DeprecationWarning`. The transcript confirms this: the second run (without the flag) shows "13 passed, 2 warnings" with the exact DeprecationWarning messages the issue describes. This means the `-W error::DeprecationWarning` flag is somehow not promoting these warnings to errors as expected, allowing the check to pass before any work is done. A check that passes both before and after implementation cannot discriminate "done" from "untouched" and therefore cannot grade the work.
